title: Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter in autonomy-rails plugins

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier, must match the directory name

description.description: Trigger description explaining what the skill does and when to invoke it

user-invocable.description: Whether the skill appears in the slash command menu

context.description: Set to fork to run in a subagent

model.description: Model override when skill is active
